title: feat(console): list table scrolls inside the page below banners; data-table right-edge scroll shadow (objectui#12463)
body:
Fixes #12463
Clause-②: no

## What this changes

1. **Console inset (`ConsoleLayout`)** — from `lg` up the main inset is `lg:flex lg:flex-col lg:[&>*]:min-h-0`, and the three banners (draft-preview bar, unpublished-app bar, notification banners) sit in one `shrink-0` box. A route page that bounds itself (`h-full` + its own inner scroller, as the object list page does) now takes the height left after the banners. The inset keeps `overflow-y-auto overflow-x-hidden`; the phone keeps block layout.
2. **`data-table` right-edge scroll shadow** — a `pointer-events-none` overlay beside the table's scroll box, drawn while `scrollLeft + clientWidth` is less than `scrollWidth`, gone at the far right. It sits at the seam before the right-pinned columns (the auto-pinned row-actions column) and clear of the box's own scrollbars; driven by a `scroll` listener plus a `ResizeObserver` on the box and the table. It replaces the box's static `shadow-[inset_…]`, which the cells' own opaque backgrounds painted over so it never showed. Grouped sub-tables (`disableInnerScroll`) draw none.

No new prop, schema key, export or locale key (Clause-② stays `no`; the two new `data-testid` attributes are DOM markers, not props).

## Premise check (measured, before the change)

Measured in Chromium (`/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`) on a scratch harness in `apps/console` (never committed, deleted after): the real `@object-ui/layout` `AppShell` with the console inset's classes, the `RouteFader`-style `h-full` wrapper, `ObjectView`'s page-root and list wrapper classes copied verbatim, and the real `ListView` → `object-grid` → `data-table` with 50 rows × 12 fields. A full console + backend was not run (no installed backend in this container).

- **1440×800, no banner, origin/main:** the data-table box is already the only y-scroller (scrollHeight 2098 / clientHeight 565); after `scrollTop = 400` the page header stays at y 56, the `thead` at y 202, the `record-count-bar` at y 767 (in view); the inset's `scrollTop` stays 0. ⇒ The card's mechanism assumption that no ancestor is a bounded scroller does not hold for this path: the header already sticks.
- **1024, origin/main:** the leading cell and the first data column are `sticky` (left 240 and 279 at every `scrollLeft`), the actions column `sticky` at the right edge (957–1024). `frozenColumns` already defaults to 1 in `object-grid` (`schema.frozenColumns ?? 1`) and the actions column is already auto-pinned right. ⇒ Nothing to add for the sticky columns; no right-edge shadow was visible.
- **With any banner above the route (a 40 px bar), origin/main:** the inset overflows by exactly the banner's height (scrollHeight 784 / clientHeight 744) and becomes a second scroller: the record-count footer sits at y 807, below the 800 px fold, and the page header scrolls away once the table reaches its end. This is the defect the card describes, and what change 1 fixes.

## Browser readings after the change (same harness)

| case | inset scrollHeight / clientHeight | inset scrollTop after scrolling | footer y |
|---|---|---|---|
| list page, 1440×800, banner | 744 / 744 | 0 | 767 (visible) |
| list page, 1440×800, no banner | 744 / 744 | 0 | 767 |
| natural-height page (search results / marketplace shape), no banner | 2096 / 744 (unchanged) | 1352 (unchanged) | n/a |
| natural-height page, banner | 2136 / 744 (unchanged) | 1392 (unchanged) | n/a |
| kanban, banner | 744 / 744 (was 784) | 0 (was 40) | 767 |
| list page, 390 wide, banner | 784 / 744 (unchanged: phone keeps block layout) | 40 | 807 |

At 1024: shadow present at `scrollLeft` 0 and 300 (x 933–957, the seam before the actions column), absent at the far right.

Pages that rely on the inset scroll were enumerated by their root classes: the search results page and the marketplace pages are natural-height (no `h-full`); record detail, dashboards, reports, metadata pages and page views bound themselves. The natural-height shape is pinned (jsdom class contract) and measured above.

## Tests (head `fe579e97b`)

- New: `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/__tests__/data-table-scroll-shadow-12463.test.tsx` (box is the `flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-auto` scroller with the sticky header inside; leading + first column pinned left, actions right; shadow present at `scrollLeft` 0 and 300, absent at the end, offset clear of a 12 px scrollbar plus the pinned column; none for `disableInnerScroll`) — geometry stubbed on the element, `scroll` event fired.
- New: `packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.inPageScroll-12463.test.tsx` (50 rows in a 600 px host: the body is the `flex-1 min-h-0` item, the toolbar precedes and the 50-record footer follows it, both outside it; kanban sits in the same body with no table box).
- New: `packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/ConsoleLayout.inPageScroll-12463.test.tsx` (the inset's `lg` flex column + `min-h-0` children, still `overflow-y-auto`, no unprefixed flex; the banner box `shrink-0` above the route; a natural-height page unwrapped under the scrolling inset).
- jsdom does no layout: the scrolling itself is the browser reading above, not these tests.
- Ablation (committed fix, mutated through `ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty): end-of-scroll condition replaced by `scrollWidth > clientWidth` → the shadow test turned red (1 failed / 3 passed); the inset's `lg:flex lg:flex-col lg:[&>*]:min-h-0` removed → the ConsoleLayout test turned red (1 failed / 2 passed).
- On `fe579e97b`: `vitest run packages/app-shell/src/layout/ packages/components/src/renderers/complex/__tests__/` + the ListView pin: 99 files / 705 tests passed. Before the merge commit: `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/` + `packages/plugin-list/` 160 files / 1626 tests passed; the 32 test files outside `src/layout` that mount `ConsoleLayout` (AppContent, console app) + two ObjectView tests: 34 / 316 passed.
- `type-check` for components, plugin-list, app-shell (after the closure build): exit 0.
- Narrowed, declared for CI: the full `packages/app-shell/src/views/` directory (about 930 test files, over the foreground cap). No file under it changed; the consumers of the changed files were run as listed.

## Gates

`pnpm check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `control-bytes`, `new-line-citations`: all exit 0. `node scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `check-changeset-no-major.mjs`: exit 0. `check:spec-floors`: exit 1, the known red on main (objectui#12334), not touched here.

Lint, narrowed to the 5 changed source/test files (`eslint --no-inline-config --format json`): 0 new findings. The one error (`react-hooks/static-components` in `data-table.tsx`, far above the edit) and the 39 warnings are byte-for-byte the base file's count when the base blob is linted the same way. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- The card's change 1 premise is half-true: without a banner the list table already scrolled inside the page under a sticky header with the footer in view (reading above); the inset double-scroll happens whenever a banner is above the route. Change 1 fixes that case; the landing seat's browser reading on the HotCRM Leads list decides whether the maintainer's environment had a banner.
- Change 1 is shell-level, so a kanban or calendar page with a banner also stops overflowing the inset by the banner's height (their own scrolling is untouched). Recorded so the seat can judge it against the ruling that other visualizations keep today's scrolling.
- The shadow's offsets are measured values passed through `style` (`right` / `bottom`), the same way this file already passes the frozen cells' measured `left` and the pinned cells' `right`; its colour is a theme token class (`from-foreground/10`).

## Merge

`origin/main` merged once more right before opening (`d25585cff`, a merge commit). Hot files shared with #12440, #12418, #12462 and PR #12443 are untouched here: `ObjectView.tsx` and `ListView.tsx` needed no change.
